اعتذروا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَذَرُوا (iʕtaḏarū) /iʕ.ta.ða.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
# اُعْتُذِرُوا (uʕtuḏirū) /uʕ.tu.ði.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
# اِعْتَذِرُوا (iʕtaḏirū) /iʕ.ta.ði.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
